publication_name: Consumer Price Index, 2025 base, all items, Japan, monthly index
access_description: The official long series is the e-Stat file catalogue linked from the Statistics Bureau results page. The e-Stat API requires an application ID. No account was created and no table was downloaded.
auth_requirement: Credential required. The e-Stat API FAQ says an application ID must be issued after sign-up. No account was created.
conditions: Credential required. Do not create an e-Stat account and do not collect this series until the founder supplies an application ID. The Statistics Bureau site terms and the e-Stat terms permit reproduction, public transmission, adaptation, and commercial use, with source citation. Those terms do not make the unauthenticated API available. Do not import zmi2025aa.csv: the results page labels it a three-decimal reference file and says the official index remains published to one decimal place.
revision_behaviour: Not collected. The official file would be a latest-revised index, not a vintage panel. Fiscal-year average files are a different series.
unresolved_questions: The e-Stat table identifier was not retrieved because the API requires an application ID. zmi2025s.csv and zmi2025c.csv returned HTTP 404 on 2026-10-24, so there is no stable unauthenticated official index file at those addresses.
evidence_note: Rights pending for automated collection: credential required. The Statistics Bureau terms read on 2026-10-24 are Public Data Licence 1.0, dated 7 March 2025, and allow reproduction, public transmission, adaptation, and commercial use, with citation. The e-Stat terms, read the same day, say the same and are compatible with CC BY 4.0. The e-Stat API FAQ says use requires sign-up and an application ID. The results page points the 2025-base long series to e-Stat statistics code 00200573. The direct file zmi2025aa.csv is the reference index to three decimal places from January 2025, and the page says it is not the official one-decimal publication. No observations were stored. This dataset id is not an input to Sahm, labour, prices, industrial production, credit, SLOOS, Census, or MACRO_CONDITIONS_PANEL. Assessed 2026-10-24.
